 Lee Kang-in Involved in Opening Goal, but Atletico Suffers Comeback Loss to Barcelona
 Kim Hyeong-yeol 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.09 07:26 
 View 
 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 ▲ Atletico's Lee Kang-in (right) battles for the ball 
 Atletico Madrid's Lee Kang-in contributed to the sequence leading to the opening goal against Barcelona, but the team failed to defend its lead, suffering a comeback defeat and seeing its winning streak snapped. 
 Atletico lost 1-2 to Barcelona after conceding multiple goals to Fermin Lopez in the home match of the 2026-2027 Spanish La Liga 12th round held at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid, Spain, on November 9. 
 Barcelona maintained its lead at the top of the table with 11 wins and 1 loss, accumulating 33 points. 
 On the other hand, Atletico, which had been enjoying a brisk seven-match winning streak, could have reclaimed the top spot with a victory on this day, but remained at 28 points with 9 wins, 1 draw, and 2 losses, dropping to third place behind Real Madrid (30 points). 
 On this day, Lee started upfront alongside Julian Alvarez in a 4-4-2 formation and played for 60 minutes. 
 He recorded one shot and did not register an attacking point. 
 Lee has now appeared in 14 of Atletico's 15 official matches played this season. 
 In La Liga, he has featured in all 12 matches (starting 10), recording 2 goals and 1 assist. 
 Both teams expressed regret in the early minutes as Marc Pubill's header for Atletico in the 6th minute and Pedri's left-footed shot for Barcelona a minute later both struck the crossbar. 
 It was Atletico that broke the deadlock in the 10th minute of the first half. 
 Lee's perceptive switch of play served as the catalyst for the opening goal. 
 Receiving the ball on the right side of the opponent's half, Lee delivered an outside-of-the-boot left-footed cross toward Alvarez, who was infiltrating the opposite side. Alvarez then quickly drove a low cross from the left side of the penalty area toward the goalmouth, where Giuliano Simeone rushed in and finished it with his right foot. 
 Lee attempted a left-footed shot from the right side of the penalty area after receiving a pass from Alex Baena in the 24th minute of the first half, but it went straight to the goalkeeper. 
 The match was brought back to level terms in the 45th minute of the first half. 
 Barcelona's Pedri shook off the defense with individual skill and sent the ball into the goalmouth. After the ball deflected off a defender, Lopez struck a first-time left-footed shot to equalize, ending the first half tied at 1-1. 
 Lee played until the 15th minute of the second half before being substituted for Alexander Sorloth. 
 Barcelona subsequently succeeded in turning the game around in the 21st minute of the second half. 
 Lopez drove a first-time right-footed shot into the net from a pass delivered by Lamine Yamal from the right side of the penalty area to the right side of the goal area, overturning the match. 
 Atletico exerted maximum effort to equalize afterwards but failed to breach Barcelona's goal again, kneeling at home. 
 Atletico suffered its second consecutive defeat in official matches, following a 0-2 home loss to Bayern Munich (Germany) in the fourth match of the UEFA Champions League league phase on November 4.
